## Parent

- Slice 2A implementation plan, section 4.1 (command fate table) and ticket R3, decision D2A-6: https://github.com/devuser/Lumen/blob/7bbf8a58f8e2b1189fee60bfa0e7075ffac4de2e/docs/research/feed-retrieval-slice2a-plan-2026-07-11.html
- Campaign branch: `feat/feed-retrieval-slice2a`

## What to build

`retrieve` becomes the only search interface; the old search surfaces are deleted, not deprecated. Remove `search`, `search-chunks`, `related`, `feed`, and `rg`: their dispatch entries, flag tables, unshared SQL, schema definitions, and tests. Keep the shared helpers `retrieve` reuses (query normalization, pagination, the coverage resolver).

Rewrite the feed skill workflows that referenced pruned verbs onto the survivors: content search goes to `retrieve`, chronological listing to `articles`, full-article reading to `deref`/`read`. The owner accepted this as a hard cutover with no transition period.

Decide the fate of the article-grain FTS tables (`articles_search`, `live_posts_search`): if nothing surviving reads them after the prune, drop the indexes too; record the decision either way.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The five commands are gone from dispatch, help, the JSON schema, and SKILL.md; invoking one produces a clear error naming the replacement
- [ ] SKILL.md carries the replacement workflow table (old command to new command) and every documented workflow uses only surviving verbs
- [ ] No dead code from pruned surfaces remains (mechanical sweep)
- [ ] Article-grain FTS index decision recorded in implementation notes
- [ ] Suite and typecheck green after test deletion
